storyTitle: Fed funds futures now price a December hike, not a cut
insight: Markets now give a December Fed hike about 90% odds and any cut just 2%: not cutting is already a form of tightening.
linkedin:
Markets now price a Fed hike at 90%, and a cut at 2%.

Fed funds futures see a quarter-point hike at the December 9 meeting, after Chair Kevin Warsh's recent inflation warnings.

When a cut stops being the base case, financial conditions tighten before the Fed does anything.

That is the backdrop to this week's chip sell-off, with Nvidia down 5.86% on Tuesday.

leaders.title: Netflix Bets That Human Taste Beats the Algorithm, Even as It Buys AI
leaders.post:
Netflix says its own data should never write the story.

Co-CEO Ted Sarandos told Bloomberg's Emily Chang that viewers quit House of Cards at minute one, when Underwood kills a dog and breaks the fourth wall, and that moment defined the show.

His case: data finds an audience, but judgment creates demand, even as Netflix pays a reported near-$600 million for Ben Affleck's AI firm.

The stock is down roughly 40% from its peak, so the bet is being tested.
